name: Updater
summary: Keeps the island and your modules up to date from GitHub.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.reason: Reads which versions exist on GitHub and downloads the updates you choose

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES
permissions.reason: Installs updates you confirm; Android asks you each time

permissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.reason: Tells you once when a new version is out

privacy: Only asks GitHub which versions exist and downloads the updates you tap. Nothing about you or your phone is sent.
